description: Gather SSH public keys from servers.

tip: Force the use of IPv4 addresses only.
Force the use of IPv6 addresses only.

option.name: -c
tip: Request certificates from target hosts instead of plain keys.

option.name: -D
tip: Print keys found as SSHFP DNS records.
The default is the known_hosts format.

option.name: -f
tip: Read hosts or "addrlist namelist" pairs from a file, one per line.
Use - to read from standard input.

option.name: -H
tip: Hash all hostnames and addresses in the output.
Hashed names remain usable by ssh and sshd but do not reveal identifying information.

option.name: -O
tip: At present the only option is hashalg=sha1 or hashalg=sha256 for -D output; the default prints both.

option.name: -p
tip: Connect to the given port on the remote host.

option.name: -q
tip: Quiet mode: do not print the server host name and banner in comments.

option.name: -t
tip: Specify the key types to fetch from the scanned hosts.
Multiple types may be separated by commas.
The default is to fetch all types.

option.name: -T
tip: Set the timeout for connection attempts.

option.name: -v
tip: Verbose mode: print debugging messages about progress.
